module_summary: Sequential 16x16 shift-add multiplier: 3-state FSM iterates, adding shifted multiplicand into accumulator per multiplier LSB.

anchors.name: n9_044
anchors.why: Idle/run/finish controller; loads operands, iterates shift-add, pulses done.

anchors.name: n6_243
anchors.why: Multiplicand shift register, shifted left each iteration.

anchors.name: n2_d93
anchors.why: Multiplier shift register; LSB selects whether to add, shifted right.

anchors.name: n12_12a
anchors.why: Product accumulator updated with partial sum; drives product output.

anchors.name: n10_368
anchors.why: Partial sum: accumulator plus multiplicand when multiplier LSB set.

anchors.name: n13_021
anchors.why: Iteration counter; terminal value ends run state.

anchors.name: n5_9ab
anchors.why: Last-iteration flag moving FSM to finish.

anchors.name: n0_9d7
anchors.why: Start input; in idle loads operands and begins multiply.

anchors.name: n4_fa5
anchors.why: One-cycle done pulse when product ready.

anchors.name: n7_37e
anchors.why: Busy status high during run state.

groups.name: mul_controller
groups.description: FSM with iteration counter sequencing load, sixteen shift-add steps, done.

groups.name: shift_add_datapath
groups.description: Operand shift registers, conditional adder and product accumulator.
